info.name: Inkomoko Fineract integration
info.description: Every call a reviewer needs, in the order to make them: health, GL sync, one loan from client to repayment, idempotency, reconciliation, failure switches and the Mock ERP. All data is made up. Import postman/local.postman_environment.json as well and pick it as the environment, or edit the collection variables. Repo: https://github.com/wmnjuguna/Inkomoko-Interview.git

exec: // One fresh run id per collection run, so references and the client_uid never clash.
// After the last request, clear the run id so the next run starts fresh.

item.name: 1 Health
item.description: Every service answers on 127.0.0.1 only. Run this first after `make up`.

item.name: 2 GL sync
item.description: Copies the ERP chart of accounts into Fineract through the plugin. Setup already did this once, so a repeat writes nothing: every account stays SYNCED and `writes` is 0.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('nothing left pending or failed', () => { const c = pm.response.json().counts; pm.expect(c.SYNC_PENDING).to.eql(0); pm.expect(c.FAILED).to.eql(0); });

item.name: 3 One loan, start to finish
item.description: Run these in order. Each run gets fresh references from the `run` variable, so you can press Run as often as you like. Every write carries an `external_reference`; send the same one again and you get the same answer, never a second payout.

exec: pm.test("principal is a field, with its range from Fineract", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().fields.map(f => f.name)).to.include('principal'));
pm.test("the full principal, from Fineract's template", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().approved_principal).to.eql(5000000));

request.description: Everything I know about one reference: status, ERP status and the full history.

exec: pm.test("the op key names the operation", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().operations[0].op_key).to.eql('DSB:PM-DSB-' + pm.variables.get('run')));

item.name: 4 Idempotency, see for yourself
item.description: The same payout sent again is answered from the saved record. A changed body or a second reference for the same payout is refused, and nothing reaches Fineract.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('the saved answer, not a second payout', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().external_reference).to.eql('PM-DSB-' + pm.variables.get('run')));
pm.test("a loan is paid out once", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('LOAN_ALREADY_DISBURSED'));

item.name: 5 Reconciliation
item.description: Compares Fineract with the ERP and gives each reference one outcome. Right after a write you may see IN_FLIGHT for a few seconds, until the outbox has sent the entry.

item.name: 6 Break things on purpose
item.description: First the ERP goes down: the repayment still succeeds, because Fineract has the money, and the journal entry waits in the outbox. Then Fineract goes down behind the fault proxy: nothing is sent, the caller gets 503, and the same reference succeeds once Fineract is back. Every switch is turned off again at the end.

item.name: Repay while the ERP is down

exec: pm.test("the entry waits in the outbox", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().erp_status).to.eql('PENDING'));

request.description: COMPLETED once the outbox has sent it. If it still says ERP_PENDING, the retry is a few seconds away: send this again.

exec: pm.test("completed, or still retrying on its own", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().operations[0].status).to.be.oneOf(['COMPLETED', 'ERP_PENDING']));
pm.test("nothing was sent, and I say so", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('FINERACT_UNAVAILABLE'));

item.name: Same reference again, now it works

request.description: Before sending, the service looks the reference up in Fineract, so a late first attempt could never be doubled.

item.name: 7 Mock ERP
item.description: The accounting side. Only the Integration Service writes here during a loan; these calls read what it posted, and add one manual entry.

request.description: The outbox posts entries a moment after Fineract answers. A 404 here means it has not arrived yet: run 6's recovery pass, or send this again.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('built from Fineract: debit 1200, credit 1100', () => { const l = pm.response.json().lines; pm.expect(l.find(x => x.account_code === '1200').debit).to.eql(5000000); pm.expect(l.find(x => x.account_code === '1100').credit).to.eql(5000000); });
pm.test("balanced, total is the debit side", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().total).to.eql(1000));
